resolvedFindings.finding: The first populated-schema V4.7 attempt omitted the existing TIME value branch and MySQL DDL auto-committed before Flyway recorded success.
resolvedFindings.resolution: The partial DDL was reconstructed to the V4.6 contract without losing 99 TIME rows, the failed history row was removed, V4.7 was corrected before successful application, and populated plus empty MySQL replay now passes.

resolvedFindings.finding: V4.7 did not include RICH_TEXT in the search projection check and had already been applied successfully.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Executed migration V4.7 remained immutable; forward migration V4.8 replaces only the search constraint and remote/empty replay both report V4.8.0.

resolvedFindings.finding: Activation rebuilt unique reservations from an API-shaped aggregate where SECRET plaintext is intentionally null.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Activation now reuses persisted versioned blind-index rows for sensitive unique fields; module tests and live activation/query acceptance pass.

resolvedFindings.finding: Generated sensitive permissions initially used a permission type not accepted by the existing platform catalog.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Sensitive read/query permissions use the established FIELD type and live catalog synchronization registers all three required capabilities.

resolvedFindings.finding: A report timestamp changed on every database-first generator execution even when schema and output were identical.
resolvedFindings.resolution: GeneratorCli retains generatedAt when report content is unchanged; two runs now produce no report or generated-tree change.

resolvedFindings.finding: The first V2 cold start exposed a damaged nested hibernate-validator stream that the prior long-lived JVM had not reloaded.
resolvedFindings.resolution: The process was stopped, the full reactor was clean-packaged, all 38,760 entries in 101 nested jars were decompressed successfully, and both rotation and second-restart acceptance then passed.

completionBoundary: P4-C2-02 typed query, indexing, uniqueness, sensitive authorization and key-version compatibility is complete. P4-C2-03 desktop/mobile controls, browser acceptance and packaged ordinary-member journey remain open; neither P4-C2 nor the final management system is complete.
